items.title: Fixture Roasters Café, Indiranagar
items.address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India

reviews.name: Anika S.
reviews.text: Lovely pour-over and friendly staff. The cold brew is the best I have had in the city.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, see you again soon!

reviews.name: Rohan
reviews.text: Good coffee but the café was very crowded on Sunday and my order took twenty minutes.

reviews.name: Priya
reviews.text: Great beans to take home. Wish there were more seats near the window.
